# ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io Daily Update (May 19, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day saw significant progress in resolving several long-standing technical issues, particularly concerning interop hard fork implementation, RPC namespace refactoring, and brotli channel divergence. A new pull request was opened to add MyAI (MYAI) to Base Mainnet.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

No new features, bug fixes, code refactoring, documentation enhancements, tests, or other work were completed today.

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
A new pull request, [#1317](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1317), was opened to add MyAI (MYAI) to Base Mainnet.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Interop Hard Fork and RPC Namespace Refactoring
Two issues related to the interop hard fork and RPC namespaces were closed. The implementation of the interop hard fork using the L2CM upgrade mechanism in both `kona-node` and `op-node` was closed as the work is being tracked elsewhere [#20082](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20082). The issue concerning the replacement of the supervisor RPC namespace with the interop filter namespace was closed, with the work completed in #20778 [#20005](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20005).

### Brotli Channel Divergence Resolution
The issue addressing the disagreement between Kona and op-node on brotli channels was closed, as all concerns and more were fixed. Follow-up work is being tracked in #20666 and an upstream brotli fix [#19333](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19333).

### Dispute Game Test Migration
The task to migrate remaining dispute game tests from `op-e2e/super_test.go` to `op-acceptance-tests` was marked as done [#20814](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20814).

### `debug_executePayload` Investigation
An investigation into whether `debug_executePayload` and related crates could be removed concluded that they are not removable as dead code, being an active, opt-in fast-path with a maintained server implementation in `op-reth` [#20879](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20879).

## NEW ISSUES

No new issues were opened today.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### SDM: Flashblocks Integration
The integration of SDM with flashblocks flows, including updates to `rollup-boost` and `op-rbuilder`, and the addition of integration tests, is currently blocked on issue #20599 [#20175](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20175).

### Interop Proofs Devnet Deployment
Progress is being made on deploying a network with SuperRootMigrations and InteropPortal contract feature flags. The goal is to ensure interop software works with the latest contracts and to automate deployment. The devnet will be used for long-term internal testing, with results to be placed in a Notion document. The Definition of Done (DoD) includes a superdispute game played, withdrawals, proofs team approval, flashblocks working with interop, and conductor re-orgs working [#20489](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20489).

### Devnet Spin-up
The plan for spinning up a devnet is to wait for `glamsterdam-devnet-4` images to be ready before attempting a full devnet in the infrastructure. Currently, efforts are focused on getting a local devnet running using `bal-devnet-6` images [#20691](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20691).

### Flaky Test: `TestSupernodeInterop_SafeHeadProgression`
A flake observed in pipeline 125516 for `TestSupernodeInterop_SafeHeadProgression` has been identified, and a fix PR has been opened: ethereum-optimism/optimism#20852 [#20851](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20851).

### Flaky Test: `TestChallengerCountersPreGenesisGame`
Investigation into the flaky test `TestChallengerCountersPreGenesisGame` is complete, and a proposed fix is in #20874. The root cause was identified as a timing issue where the migration wall-clock varies with CI load, causing a collision with the `plannedRollupStartBlockNumber`. The fix involves increasing the `preGenesisRollupStartBlockDelay` and adding a post-migration L1-head re-read with a fast-fail invariant [#20869](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20869).
